sections.title: E-commerce store design
sections.text: We design the catalog, product pages and checkout flow so shoppers get from landing to ordering with as little friction as possible, and we track every step to see where they drop off.

items.question: Which e-commerce platform is right for my store?
items.answer: It depends on your market, catalog size and how you handle payment and shipping. We recommend a platform after reviewing your products and operating plan.

items.question: Do you upload the products?
items.answer: Product upload and product data management is a separate service that can be added to your store project.

items.question: Do you set up payment and shipping?
items.answer: Yes. We connect the payment gateways and shipping companies available on your platform and test the order process from start to finish.

items.question: Is the store ready to rank in search?
items.answer: We set up the category structure, URLs, meta tags and speed. Ongoing work on search visibility is a separate SEO service.

items.question: Can you migrate an existing store?
items.answer: Yes, with a plan for migrating products, URLs and redirects that protects the search visibility your store has already built.

items.question: How long does it take to build an online store?
items.answer: It depends on the size of your catalog and the integrations required. We set the timeline once the scope is agreed.
